Esa última fórmula dice algo extraordina: That last formula says something extraordinary: infinitely many numbers can be added and give a finite result. $\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{4}+\frac{1}{8}+\dots = 1$. Each summand is half of what is left, so it never passes 1, but gets as close as you like. It is the resolution of the paradox of Achilles and the tortoise, which had the Greeks stuck for centuries.

Hay otra forma de decir quién es una suc: There is another way of saying what a sequence is, and it is the opposite: instead of a formula giving term $n$ in one go, a rule getting it from the previous ones plus a starting point. That is a recurrence, and it is literally the same as a function calling itself in a program: base case and rule. In [[len-funciones|the machines and languages block]] it is written that way and you see what it costs — all the half-computed terms have to be kept somewhere, and that somewhere fills up — which is exactly the practical reason why finding the general term is worth the trouble.
Igual que con las funciones, se puede pr: Just as with functions, you can ask where the terms are heading as $n$ grows without stopping. A sequence is convergent if it approaches a number, divergent if it runs off to infinity and oscillating if it cannot make up its mind.

La suma de una progresión geométrica es: The sum of a geometric progression is the formula for a mortgage payment. Each future monthly payment is worth a little less today, and that “little less” is a constant ratio, so the total is a geometric progression; the bank isolates the payment from it. The same formula gives the value of a pension plan and the reach of a campaign spreading by recommendation. That derivation, with the payment isolated and an amortisation table you can play with, is in the topic [[fn-finanzas|Financial mathematics]], two ahead.

Que una razón menor que 1 haga converger: That a ratio smaller than 1 makes a geometric converge is exactly the argument guaranteeing that an agent can learn from rewards. The method repeats an operation that brings the estimates closer: each round reduces the error by at least a factor $\gamma < 1$, so the successive errors are bounded by a geometric and tend to zero. Since the limit exists and is unique, there is one possible value and it is reached from any starting point. It is in [[ia-refuerzo|Bellman and Q-learning]].
Que una suma de infinitos términos pueda: That a sum of infinitely many terms can give a finite number is what makes digital compression possible. A sound or an image is represented as a sum of infinitely many components, but since the terms decrease quickly, keeping a few is enough: that is an MP3 and that is a JPEG. What you throw away is the tail of the series, and the reason it is not noticed is precisely that it converges.
Se calculan igual que los límites en el: They are worked out just like the limits at infinity of functions: by comparing degrees.
